plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Haritaly uses your location while you use the app to center the map on you, show how far places are and save a place where you are. It is never shared with your friends.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Haritaly only uses your location while you use the app, to center the map on you, show how far places are and save a place where you are. It is never used in the background and never shared with your friends.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Haritaly only uses your location while you use the app, to center the map on you, show how far places are and save a place where you are. It is never used in the background and never shared with your friends.

plugins.photosPermission: Haritaly lets you pick photos to add to the places you save.
plugins.cameraPermission: Haritaly uses the camera so you can take photos of the places you save.
